archive_policy: Deterministic USTAR, sorted regular UTF-8 text files, mode 0644, zero uid/gid/mtime, empty owner names.
evidence_derivation: Reports are represented by newly written bounded findings, status, exact evidence hashes and limits. Original reports and raw execution logs are not copied into this product archive.
inherited_provenance: Prior checkpoints remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Historical exact recovery, reassembled candidates, NEW implementations and derived documents retain their existing provenance. A dependency reference states byte identity to that artifact only; it never promotes reassembled or NEW work to recovered original source.

isolated_groups.chapter-provider: Three author-tested NEW inactive provider/dock/test snapshots; no independent approval.
isolated_groups.finite-core-c3: Exact reviewed tranche13, ten requested source/test snapshots.
isolated_groups.persistence-gate3: Exact gate3 manifest, thirteen requested source/test/data snapshots.
isolated_groups.streamed-boundary: Exact reviewed NEW helper and boundary test, two requested snapshots.

purpose: Inert recovery checkpoint of four separate bounded work units, not a merged runnable application.
restore_rule: Use a separate empty workspace for each group. Restore every source_mapping and dependency_mapping entry for that group at restore_target; remove only the final inert .txt suffix. Resolve references to this checkpoint or the exact inherited Git blob/archived member and verify SHA-256. Never overlay all groups into one application.
